shortDescription: HSBC Holdings LSE:HSBA has priced a 54.3 billion yen ($348.3 million) Samurai bond sale in three parts, according to a term sheet seen by Reuters on Friday.Here are more details:($1 = 155.9200 yen)

children: has priced a 54.3 billion yen ($348.3 million) Samurai bond sale in three parts, according to a term sheet seen by Reuters on Friday.

HSBC sold 21.6 billion yen of bonds due in September 2030 with a 2.769% coupon, 25.7 billion yen of notes due in September 2032 paying 3.227% and 7.0 billion yen of bonds due in September 2037 with a 3.879% coupon.
The 2030 notes were priced at 75 basis points over yen mid-swap rates, the 2032 notes at 95 basis points over swaps and the 2037 notes at 110 basis points over swaps.
They are expected to be rated A3 by Moody's and A- by S&P.
HSBC, Daiwa, Mitsubishi UFJ Morgan Stanley, Mizuho, Nomura and SMBC Nikko arranged the sale.
